title: A Heteroskedasticity-Consistent Covariance Matrix Estimator and a Direct Test for Heteroskedasticity
method_role: Method 1.1: White HC3 Small-Sample Covariance & Forecast Margin of Error

title: Economic News and Bond Prices: An Empirical Analysis of Real-Time Data
journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis, 36(4), 523–543
empirical_finding: Removes unit-of-measurement distortions across headline, core, and wage surprises into scale-invariant standard deviation shocks.

title: Bayesian Data Analysis (3rd Edition)
journal: Chapman & Hall / CRC Texts in Statistical Science
method_role: Method 1.3 & 3.3: Bayesian Conjugate Gaussian Prior-to-Posterior Updating
empirical_finding: Synthesizes historical base rates with high-frequency leading evidence (Cleveland Nowcast, WTI Oil, ADP) to calculate exact probability density regimes.

title: Option Pricing When Underlying Stock Returns Are Discontinuous / Jump-Diffusion Models
journal: Journal of Financial Economics / Management Science
method_role: Method 1.4: Merton-Kou Jump-Diffusion SDE with Volatility Decay
equation: dS_t / S_t = (mu - lambda*kappa) dt + sigma(t) dW_t + J_t dN_t,  sigma(t) = sigma_0 * (1 + kappa * e^(-t/tau))
empirical_finding: Captures post-announcement conditional price jumps with exponentially decaying volatility, generating calibrated 95% VaR and CVaR.

title: Do Actions Speak Louder Than Words? The Response of Asset Prices to Monetary Policy Actions and Statements
method_role: Method 2.1: Two-Factor Decomposition (Target Factor vs Path Factor)
equation: Delta ln(P_Gold) = gamma_0 + gamma_1 * Target_Factor + gamma_2 * Path_Factor + epsilon
empirical_finding: Proved that the forward-guidance/Dot Plot path factor accounts for over 70% of asset price variance, dominating immediate target rate decisions.

title: Monetary Policy Surprises and Interest Rates: Evidence from the Fed Funds Futures Market
method_role: Method 2.2: Fed Funds Futures Implied Rate Surprise & Bid-Ask Noise Bound
empirical_finding: Calculates unexpected policy rate adjustments from 30-Day Fed Funds Futures with strict noise-filtering thresholds.

title: A New Approach to the Economic Analysis of Nonstationary Time Series and the Business Cycle
method_role: Method 2.3: Multinomial Logistic / Probit Policy Regime Shift Classifier
equation: P(Regime_j | X) = exp(X*beta_j) / sum_k(exp(X*beta_k)),  Wald_MoE = +- 1.96 * SE(eta)
empirical_finding: Quantifies the probability transitions between Hawkish Hike, Consensus Pause, and Dovish Cut regimes.

title: Real-Time Price Discovery in Global Stock, Bond and Foreign Exchange Markets
method_role: Method 3.1 & 3.4: Labor Market High-Frequency Volatility Jump Ratio VR(w)
equation: VR(w) = sum(r_{T0+k}^2) / sum(r_{T0-k}^2),  S(t) = S_base * (1 + psi * VR(w) * e^(-lambda*t))
empirical_finding: Establishes empirical spread blowout firewall criteria during Wave 1 (T0 to T+3m) before liquidity stabilizes in Wave 2.

title: Regression Quantiles / The Asymmetric Response of Asset Prices to Macro Surprises
equation: min_{beta_tau} sum rho_tau(y_i - x_i'*beta_tau),  Width_{80%} = Q_{0.90} - Q_{0.10}
empirical_finding: Models asymmetric tail risk in precious metals without assuming normal error distributions.

title: Do Producer Prices Lead Consumer Prices?

method_role: Method 4.1: Upstream Cost Pass-Through Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL)

empirical_finding: Identifies wholesale goods pipeline cost transmission into market breakeven inflation expectations.

equation: Z_Demand = omega_PPI * Z_PPI + omega_Retail * Z_Retail,  MoE = +- 1.96 * sigma_survey

journal: Journal of Econometrics / American Economic Review
method_role: Method 5.1: Non-Linear Geopolitical Energy & Commodity Beta Engine
equation: Delta ln(P_Gold) = theta_0 + theta_1 * max(0, ln(WTI_t) - max(ln(WTI_{t-12}))) + theta_2 * Delta VIX + theta_3 * Delta DXY
